suggestions.title: Weigh in tomorrow morning — your three best eating days have no clean read behind them

rationale.science: A single scale reading is noise around a slow trend, so a trend only means something when its reads are taken the same way each time. Standardising the conditions of the measurement is what makes a small real change visible above day-to-day water (Article III; DASH-Sodium / Juraschek 2020 on how far sodium and food volume move scale weight without moving fat).
rationale.data: You ate 2,122 / 2,300 / 2,081 on 8/16, 8/17 and 8/18 — your best three-day stretch in the file. The only weigh-in behind them was yesterday's, and it was an evening read: your app posted EVENING READ — SET ASIDE five times and binned it. Your last clean morning read is 8/17 at 164.2.
rationale.relationship: Morning reads are the only ones your trend can use, so an evening read costs you the whole day's evidence, not just some of it. Two clean mornings — tomorrow and Thursday — are the first and only look at whether those three days moved anything, and Friday's call rests on them.

suggestions.predict: A morning read on 8/19 and 8/20. If the three low days are real, the trend reads at or under 163.8 by Friday 8/21. At or above 164.3 with those days logged clean, my read of your weekdays is wrong and I will say so.

suggestions.title: Hip thrust: check in SETUP what the machine actually makes before you load it Friday

rationale.science: On a cut you defend load rather than chase volume, which means every working load has to be a real number you can progress from — a guessed opener has nothing to progress against (Schoenfeld 2017; Robinson 2024).
rationale.data: exercises.hipthrust.w is still null with its pins unfilled, and Friday 8/21 is its debut. It is also the lift five others are seamed behind — calves, hanging, abs, ham and extension all start fresh baselines on that session.
rationale.relationship: A guessed load on the one session that re-anchors five other lifts lands somewhere you can never untangle later. The hack went in at 190 and had to be corrected to 200; the ham was checked in SETUP first and debuted clean at 125. Thirty seconds on the pins before the first set is the difference.

suggestions.predict: hipthrust.w carries a real number before Friday's first set, and Friday's five seamed lower lifts open against a load you can progress from. Left null, the debut logs a number neither of us can trust and five fresh baselines inherit it.
